faq_heading: Homes near Noel Booth Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Noel Booth Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Noel Booth Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Noel Booth Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Noel Booth Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 25 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,302,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Noel Booth Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Noel Booth Elementary the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 96.4% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 25 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Noel Booth Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are St Catherines School (0.6 km south), Belmont Elementary (1.0 km north) and Brookswood Secondary (1.4 km north-east).

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Noel Booth Elementary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Noel Booth Elementary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 other, 1 secondary, 1 middle; 1 independent). The closest is St Catherines School, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is H D Stafford Middle, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Brookswood Secondary (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Belmont Elementary (1.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: St Catherines School (0.6 km south), Belmont Elementary (1.0 km north), Alice Brown Elementary (2.1 km north), Uplands Elementary (2.2 km north), Glenwood Elementary (2.3 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is St Catherines School, 0.6 km south of Noel Booth Elementary.
